messages.content: Help me update the new status to 2 for a list of product IDs [101, 202, 303] in the product management system?

function.name: PmsProductServiceImpl_updateNewStatus
function.description: Updates the new status for a list of product IDs in the product management system. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

ids.description: A list of product IDs to update the new status for. Product ID is Long type This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type long; they are not in string representation.

newStatus.description: The new status to be set for the given product IDs. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning: The user wants to update the new status to 2 for product IDs 101, 202, 303. The tool expects ids as a string representation of a Java ArrayList type parameter, with elements of type long. So we need to pass ids as a string like "[101,202,303]" or "java.util.ArrayList<Long> [101,202,303]"? The description says "This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type long; they are not in string representation." So we should pass ids as a string representation of an ArrayList of longs. Usually that would be something like "[101,202,303]" or "java.util.ArrayList<Long> [101,202,303]". The newStatus is string representation of integer, so "2". We'll call the function.
